baseline_policy: Only accepted-baseline items belonging to current_accepted_resource_table_version are inherited full-resource-table design facts. The separately registered current future-route overlay may change only its explicit, versioned, non-runtime route scope; it cannot silently mutate economy-v2, historical receipts, or any unlisted economic field. Superseded accepted tables remain immutable historical evidence only. Proposals, conflicts, deferred items, and whitebox candidates are not effective data. Current accepted design data remains non-production until its independent runtime gate is opened.

offline_simulation_boundary.promotion_gate: Every listed implementation-critical decision requires explicit accepted-baseline adoption, a versioned resource table, owner scope, receipt policy, and evidence review before any production handoff.
